ARABIC MASTER EDUCATIONAL CORPUS — 5,000 EXAMPLES
============================================================

SOURCE FRAMEWORK
----------------
Expanded directly from the supplied six-language Grade 1–12 framework.
Coverage: literacy, pronunciation/phonetics, grammar, syntax, literature,
writing, morals/ethics, EVS, environmental awareness, civic responsibility,
and advanced composition.

SCRIPT / DIRECTION
------------------
Arabic, right-to-left

STAGES
------
الصفوف ١-٥, الصفوف ٦-٨, الصفوف ٩-١٠, الصفوف ١١-١٢

CORPUS DESIGN
-------------
Each example contains:
1. Learning stage
2. Topic
3. Task/instruction
4. Target skill
5. Context
6. Expected response pattern
7. Grammar/linguistic focus
8. EVS/value connection
9. Difficulty progression
10. Evaluation checklist

Important: this is an expanded educational corpus generated from the supplied
framework. It is not a replacement for a specific board's official textbook
or syllabus.


EXAMPLE 0001
--------------
Language: Arabic
Stage: الصفوف ١-٥
Topic: المنصوبات
Difficulty: Foundational: recognition, tracing, simple vocabulary, short sentences

TASK
----
اربط بين {topic} وحماية البيئة والمسؤولية المدنية.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to المنصوبات. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in المنصوبات, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

RESEARCH / MODEL-TRAINING TAGS
------------------------------

topic=المنصوبات

script_direction=rtl
has_evs=false
has_moral=false
has_grammar=false

EXAMPLE 1087
--------------
Language: Arabic
Stage: الصفوف ١-٥
Topic: المفردات
Difficulty: Foundational: recognition, tracing, simple vocabulary, short sentences

TASK
----
قارن بين مفهومين مرتبطين بـ{topic}.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to المفردات. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in المفردات, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Stage: الصفوف ١-٥
Topic: ترشيد استهلاك الماء
Difficulty: Foundational: recognition, tracing, simple vocabulary, short sentences

TASK
----
اشرح القيمة الأخلاقية المرتبطة بـ{topic}.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to ترشيد استهلاك الماء. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in ترشيد استهلاك الماء, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Language: Arabic
Stage: الصفوف ٦-٨
Topic: الرسائل الرسمية
Difficulty: Structural: grammar application, prose comprehension, guided composition

TASK
----
قارن بين مفهومين مرتبطين بـ{topic}.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to الرسائل الرسمية. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in الرسائل الرسمية, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

RESEARCH / MODEL-TRAINING TAGS
------------------------------
language=arabic
stage=2
topic=الرسائل_الرسمية
task_type=8
script_direction=rtl
has_evs=false

has_grammar=true

CONTEXT

from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------

grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION

patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water

EXAMPLE 2050
--------------
Language: Arabic
Stage: الصفوف ٦-٨
Topic: حقوق الإنسان
Difficulty: Structural: grammar application, prose comprehension, guided composition

TASK
----
حدد الوظيفة النحوية للكلمة المحددة في جملة تتعلق بـ{topic}.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to حقوق الإنسان. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in حقوق الإنسان, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

EXAMPLE 2088
--------------

Difficulty: Structural: grammar application, prose comprehension, guided composition

TASK
----

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to إن وأخواتها. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in إن وأخواتها, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

------------

grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------

Difficulty: Advanced school: syntax, rhetoric, analysis, formal writing

TASK
----
اربط بين {topic} وحماية البيئة والمسؤولية المدنية.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to الرسائل الرسمية. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in الرسائل الرسمية, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EXAMPLE 3187
--------------
Language: Arabic
Stage: الصفوف ٩-١٠
Topic: الصفة والحال
Difficulty: Advanced school: syntax, rhetoric, analysis, formal writing

TASK
----
حدد الوظيفة النحوية للكلمة المحددة في جملة تتعلق بـ{topic}.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to الصفة والحال. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in الصفة والحال, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Difficulty: Advanced school: syntax, rhetoric, analysis, formal writing

TASK
----
لخّص فقرة عن {topic} في كلمات قليلة.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to الاسم والضمير. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in الاسم والضمير, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EXAMPLE 3880
--------------
Language: Arabic
Stage: الصفوف ١١-١٢
Topic: المفردات
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
حوّل الجملة المتعلقة بـ{topic} إلى الصيغة المطلوبة.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to المفردات. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in المفردات, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Language: Arabic
Stage: الصفوف ١١-١٢
Topic: القيم الأخلاقية
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
أنشئ ثلاثة أسئلة وأجوبة حول {topic}.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to القيم الأخلاقية. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in القيم الأخلاقية, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

RESEARCH / MODEL-TRAINING TAGS
------------------------------

script_direction=rtl

has_grammar=false

Stage: الصفوف ١١-١٢
Topic: التنمية المستدامة
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
قارن بين مفهومين مرتبطين بـ{topic}.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to التنمية المستدامة. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in التنمية المستدامة, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

EXAMPLE 4696
--------------
Language: Arabic
Stage: الصفوف ١١-١٢
Topic: الرسائل الرسمية
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
اكتب رسالة رسمية تتعلق بـ{topic}.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to الرسائل الرسمية. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in الرسائل الرسمية, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Stage: الصفوف ١١-١٢
Topic: الجملة الاسمية
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
اشرح القيمة الأخلاقية المرتبطة بـ{topic}.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to الجملة الاسمية. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in الجملة الاسمية, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

حوّل الجملة المتعلقة بـ{topic} إلى الزمن المطلوب.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to الاسم والضمير. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in الاسم والضمير, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level
